<h3>Upcoming deprecations</h3>
<p>The dates below are announced compatibility review/removal windows, not removals made by this beta. Existing removal-pending compatibility stays in place until its documented migration, published-reader, data-preservation, and approval requirements are met. Update integrations to the replacements below before their window.</p>
<ul>
<li>plugin-sdk-session-agent-resolution-aliases — 2026-11-29: <code>resolveSessionAgentIdsStrict</code> and <code>resolveSessionAgentIdStrict</code> with an explicit agent, agent-scoped session key, prepared fallback, or persisted owner. See /plugins/compatibility#session-agent-resolution-aliases. <h3>Upcoming deprecations</h3>
<p>The dates below are announced compatibility review/removal windows, not removals made by this beta. Existing removal-pending compatibility stays in place until its documented migration, published-reader, data-preservation, and approval requirements are met. Update integrations to the replacements below before their window.</p>
<ul>
<li>plugin-sdk-session-agent-resolution-aliases — 2026-11-29: <code>resolveSessionAgentIdsStrict</code> and <code>resolveSessionAgentIdStrict</code> with an explicit agent, agent-scoped session key, prepared fallback, or persisted owner. See /plugins/compatibility#session-agent-resolution-aliases.
